Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams audio chunks from an async source using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import asyncio
import aiohttp
from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech

async def stream_speech_to_text(audio_source):
    client = speech.SpeechClient()
    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        sample_rate_hertz=16000,
        language_code="en-US",
    )
    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(config=config, interim_results=True)

    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.post(
            "https://streaming.googleapis.com/v1/speech:streamingRecognize",
            data=streaming_config.SerializeToString(),
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/octet-stream"},
        ) as resp:
            async for response in resp.content:
                result = speech.StreamingRecognitionResult.from_string(response)
                if result.results:
                    print("Transcript: {}".format(result.results[0].alternatives[0].transcript))

# Example usage with an async audio source
async def audio_source():
    # Simulate an async audio source
    for i in range(10):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
        yield b'\x00\x01\x02\x03'  # Dummy audio data

async def main():
    audio_stream = audio_source()
    await stream_speech_to_text(audio_stream)

asyncio.run(main())
```
